name: Jörgen Stenson
source:
Ida's owner and master during the reduced IQ ending of Holly Smiles at The End. When he appears in this visual novel, he has already fully sexually corrupted Ida into his sex slave.

We are unsure of how much time has passed since the Fictional Story visual novel. 


[spoiler]Note that he get's punished, during this ending, for being too horny for even the main antagonist of this game.[spoiler]

[spoiler]This punishment includes being forcibly sex changed into a woman, teleported to a hell-like area, and then auctioned off to a demon where Jörgen is violated for the foreseeable future.[spoiler]
